digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler - binding store snapshot commit
propositions: reconcile_helpers.py unconditionally imports rebar_reconciler.git_adapter at line 200, causing ModuleNotFoundError when loaded as a standalone module without a parent package
reconcile.py loads reconcile_helpers under a flat key without creating an importable parent package, violating the documented standalone execution contract
the binding store commit helper fails before reaching its documented True/False result branches and fail-open semantics
the fix must restore package-free loading while preserving cache identity, git operations, and the boolean commit-back contract
standalone and package-context execution must resolve to the same sys.modules object for rebar_reconciler.git_adapter
